name: Keldons
description: The warrior people of Keld, led by Radha.

description_citations.text: "Radha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The original Keldons come from Parma under Kradak to escape the cold.
timeline.quote: The original Keldons came over from Parma led by Kradak to escape the deadly cold of that land.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Founding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gatha's experiments transform Keldons into nightmarish warriors, the mightiest being Kreig.
timeline.quote: His experiments transformed the Keldons into nightmarish warriors, the mightiest of which was the witch-king Kreig .

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Rise and Fall of Gatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: True-blooded Keldons regain the Doyen Council and make war on the Gathans.
timeline.quote: The true-blooded Keldons regained control of the Doyen Council and made war on the Gathans.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Rise and Fall of Gatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's geneticist Gatha defects and uses his knowledge to improve the Keldon race.
timeline.quote: One of his geneticists, Gatha , defects, and uses his knowledge to improve the Keldon race.

citation.text: "Urza's Destiny", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Keldons smash all unfamiliar statues after a chimeric idol attacks them.
timeline.quote: After a chimeric idol attacked them, the Keldons smashed all unfamiliar statues.

citation.text: Chimeric Idol (Prophecy, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Keldons took several trenching steeds as trophies of war.
timeline.quote: The Keldons took several of the steeds as trophies of war.

citation.text: Trenching Steed (Prophecy, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jamuraa suffers a Keldon invasion during the Prophecy War, just before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Jamuraa was subject to a Keldon invasion right before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Two Invasions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldons launch the Prophecy War, invading Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: A few months before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria, the Keldons launched their invasion of Jamuraa.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian necromancy raises the Keldon honored dead during the battle on the frozen lake.
timeline.quote: In the heat of battle, the Keldon honored dead were raised from their graves not by Twilight, but by Phyrexian necromancy.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golden Argosy carries surviving Keldons to Urborg for the final battle against Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: The Argosy then bore them off to Urborg where they fought in the final battle of the Invasion against Yawgmoth and his forces.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldons raid the Jamuraan coast, take hostages and settle, while the Kipamu League is unable to resist.
timeline.quote: Keldon forces razed villages, captured hostages, and established a permanent settlement

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Keldon Necropolis the risen chieftains side with the Phyrexians, forcing the Keldons to slay their dead champions.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, they instead sided with their undead kin, the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Uniter of Keld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tajamin's cudgel triggers an eruption and flood, and the Golden Argosy rescues the remaining warriors and takes them to Urborg.
timeline.quote: The mythical Keldon longboat Golden Argosy emerged from the depths and saved the remaining warriors of Keld

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Uniter of Keld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The slivers overrun the forest and a time-rift links Keld to its alternate older version, and Gathan warriors attack.
timeline.quote: Soon, these time-displaced warriors attacked the true Keldons and Skyshroud's inhabitants.

citation.text: "Skyshroud Forest", section "Time Spiral crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kradak was given the Flame by the Mountain and became the first Keldon warlord.
timeline.quote: The wanderers became Keldons, and he the first warlord.

citation.text: Keldon Warcaller (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Grand Warlord Radha declares the Keldons do what is best for them, not for the past.
timeline.quote: We are Keldons!"

citation.text: Warlord's Fury (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ajani proposes speaking to the leaders at the Keldon-Benalish peace summit, and the two planeswalk to Oyster Bay.
timeline.quote: there is a peace summit between the Keldons and the Benalish.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Radha and the Keldons withdraw and lock the Phyrexians into the room with the planeswalkers, who fight them.
timeline.quote: The brass double doors slammed shut

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The Golden Argosy arrives; Radha and her Keldon warriors board the dreadnought and kill it.
timeline.quote: Hundreds of Keldon warriors leapt from the ship

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: As a boy Astor serves as a camp runner for Commander Treulk, the best messenger he had.
timeline.quote: Astor spent much of his early life as a camp runner for Commander Treulk

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olvresk takes Astor from Treulk and sends him to train under Tajamin.
timeline.quote: Olvresk took him from Treulk and sent Astor to train under Doyenne Tajamin

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disagreeing with Tajamin's methods, Olvresk storms her compound and his Fists slaughter many of her people; Tajamin saves herself and Astor by invoking the Tinder Spell.
timeline.quote: He stormed Tajamin's compound and used his Fists, his elite soldiers, to slaughter many of Tajamin's people.

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor learns the Tinder Spell in two days without food, and Tajamin teaches him of Jezal's Covenant.
timeline.quote: Two days later, Astor knew the spell

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the Mountain Astor slays a Colos for food and fights off the wolves it attracts.
timeline.quote: Astor had found food by slaying a Colos

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Mountain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the peak Astor sees a vision of Kradak, who warns of the coming Keldon Twilight, and Astor becomes a warlord.
timeline.quote: Astor stood tall at the highest peak of Keld as a warlord

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Mountain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At nineteen Astor is granted the far northern lands by Olvresk and sets out to confront a dragon that seems to have broken her oath.
timeline.quote: Astor had been granted the lands of the far north

citation.text: "Astor", section "Keldon Staredown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor finds that Skouras killed the resident dragon; Skouras tears through his troops, but Astor hurls the dead dragon's egg into Skouras's hoard as a bomb.
timeline.quote: Astor used the captured egg of the dead dragon as a bomb and hurled it into Skouras's horde

citation.text: "Astor", section "Keldon Staredown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor retreats to Letha, blows up the village to ground Skouras, and kills him by channeling the power of Keld into the dragon's mind.
timeline.quote: This had the rather spectacular effect of exploding the dragon's head.

citation.text: "Astor", section "Keldon Staredown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the battle for the Keldon Necropolis the Keldon Twilight occurs, and the fallen chieftains side with the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, they instead sided with their undead kin, the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tajamin strikes an undead champion with her cudgel, triggering an eruption and flood; the Golden Argosy saves the survivors and carries them toward Urborg.
timeline.quote: Tajamin struck one of the undead with her sacred cudgel

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, Sivi, the Keldons and elves save the Magnigoth Treefolk from the mud-men by burning them into pottery.
timeline.quote: This plan succeeded in saving the Magnigoths from the mud-men.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gatha's genetic tampering enhanced the Keldons and led to the Witch-kings.
timeline.quote: Gatha's genetic tampering enhanced the Keldons into nightmarish warriors

citation.text: "Gatha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varden's Keldons rebelled against Kreig and were easily defeated.
timeline.quote: Led by the Doyen Varden , these Keldons rebelled against Kreig but were easily defeated.

citation.text: "Gatha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians led by Croag invaded Keld.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians had taken notice of Gatha's experiments and invaded Keld

citation.text: "Gatha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jolrael helps defend northern Jamuraa from the Keldons in the Prophecy War.
timeline.quote: Jolrael helped to defend the land, using her skills with the native beasts to gain an upper hand against Keldon raiders.

citation.text: "Jolrael", section "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Latulla rises to prominence, expelling the master of her house and taking over his faction.
timeline.quote: reportedly expelling the master of her house and taking over his faction

citation.text: "Latulla", section "Rise to fame". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mageta narrowly survives his army's defeat by the Keldons and fights his way back to Arsenal City.
timeline.quote: Mageta narrowly survived the subsequent defeat of his army at the hands of the Keldons

citation.text: "Mageta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the siege of Arsenal City, Mageta leads a counterattack that wins the crucial battle.
timeline.quote: Mageta led the foot soldiers in a counterattack.

citation.text: "Mageta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mageta and Barrin lead counterattacks; Mageta fights Latulla's last attempt and routs the Keldons.
timeline.quote: When Latulla made the last attempt to defeat the Kipamu League in battle Mageta once again led his troops from the front line.

citation.text: "Mageta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haddad faces a band of Keldons led by Overseer Latulla and is enslaved.
timeline.quote: Haddad is enslaved and learns more about the culture of his captors.

citation.text: "Prophecy (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldons initiate brutal raids on the League cities, pushing the League toward the coast.
timeline.quote: The League, lacking unified leadership, suffers heavy losses and is pushed toward the coast.

citation.text: "Prophecy (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldons are defeated and their colonies destroyed; Rayne, Latulla, Greel and Haddad die, and Barrin and Teferi begin to question their roles.
timeline.quote: The story ends with the defeat of the Keldons, the destruction of their colonies in Jamuraa

citation.text: "Prophecy (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
